line.comment: * What tactics ships with no main turrets use againts stations. 0: the ship rotates around itself while firing, 1: the ship makes a full stop, 2: the ship circles around the station.
* Note, if a missile ship only, this will return the range of the least ranged missile for an M8 or M7M (not including chaff)
* Mordan8 - Added new distancing for missile-only ships. We have no need to get right on top of a target and die from return fire if it's a huge ship we're shooting at.
* Especially if we have long range missiles. Just plot points at 80% of our effective missile range instead of 50% range like it used to be.
* this second range gets used when attacking ships to determine whether we need to calculate a new circular path or can stay on our current path
* ZH 1.7 fix - we might've switched or lost target
* ZH 2.0 - first nav point was always facing north
* first nav point is now closest to the attacker. We always first head straight to this one.
* for every circular attack run we shift the entire y plane a bit to help avoid other capships and achieve smoother pathing.
* our target is moving but still in laser range. We dont need to calculate a new course
* after completing our first approach we begin to circle around the target
* Add-Ons 2.2: Attempt to fix an infinite loop. If target is docked and not a station, return null.
